name: employer-check-chat
description: IT worker employer evaluation for consulting firms from public sources and pasted reviews. Emits employer-check-report. Not legal advice.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat. MAY include company name, URLs, pasted reviews, role context, or questions.

inputs.name: company-name
inputs.description: Legal or trade name of the consulting employer to evaluate.

inputs.name: company-website
inputs.description: Public HTTPS URL (homepage, careers, or about).

inputs.name: country-or-region
inputs.description: Country or market (e.g. Brazil, Portugal, US). Drives geo-adaptive sources.

inputs.name: role-or-seniority
inputs.description: Target role (e.g. junior developer, tech lead). Tailors report and interview questions.

inputs.name: office-or-location
inputs.description: City, office, or remote/hybrid preference for multi-office consultancies.

inputs.name: review-source-urls
inputs.description: Newline- or comma-separated HTTPS URLs: Glassdoor, Teamlyzer, Reddit, Indeed.

inputs.name: review-excerpts
inputs.description: Pasted review text or forum quotes the user wants included.

inputs.name: competitor-names
inputs.description: Other consultancies to compare against (names only).

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Answers from prior interview or clarification loops.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: employer-check-report
outputs.description: Structured employer check report; empty when evidence is too thin.
